name: Imagination Station 2020

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria, follow the signs.

information:
This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are required to purchase a day pass to the science center to enter the competition. A day pass is included in the competitor registration fee.

3x3 Blindfolded Round 2 is tentative.

Since this event is in a public area, we will not be silencing the crowd for 3x3 Blindfolded.
